default.text: Oh, hello. You're the one who fell in the lake. Father says I'm not to bother the adventurers. I'm Anwen.

options.text: What's it like, living in a mill?

mill.text: Loud. Everything shakes a little, all the time. When the wind drops I can't sleep for the quiet.

bride.text: On the twenty-fourth. I've known Dunn since we were small. Everyone says I'm lucky. I am. I only wish I'd seen something first. East Watch, even.

options.text: It's all right to be scared.
East Watch is a day's walk. Go after the wedding.

bride_kind.text: Is it? Nobody's said that. They all say 'lucky'. Thank you.

bride_plain.text: With Dunn! He'd carry too much and complain the whole road. ...Yes. Maybe.

bride_hard.text: That's not... I want to. You don't understand how it is here.
